title: coleus bipartitus
intro: Coleus bipartitus, commonly known as Coleus, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical Asia and Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Coleus bipartitus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Coleus bipartitus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
